    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []

            if (r, c) in seen:

            q = [(r, c)]

            cells = []
            while q:

                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

    points = set(cells)
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in points), max(r for r,c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in points), max(c for r,c in points)
    for r in (r0, r1):
